clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1 (lead L-837): the seven v3 style swaps of cycle 17 that did not reproduce, rerun with the 0xd78218c0 Mint variant of factory 0x07e60782 read as a mint.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Rechecked on chain. eth_getCode of pool 0x0d3e8f6949dcaca02cbd1aaf7ca840f4f36216b7 on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm returns 21,609 bytes that contain 0xd78218c0 and 0x0c396cd9 and not 0x7a53080b; factory() returns 0x07e60782535752be279929e2dffdd136db2e6b45. fee() now returns 1000, so the fee moves over time, which fits the dynamic fee reading. eth_getLogs of block 50,505,119 shows the burn at ticks 199170 to 199175 (out of range for parent tick 199188), the variant at 199185 to 199190 with 12,304,701,949,129,529 in data word 2, and the Swap with liquidity 18,056,408,451,067,369 and tick 199187. liquidity() at block 50,505,118 on rpc.purroofgroup.com (reth/v0.1.0-f0cad31) is 0x146f2586e67ab0 = 5,751,706,501,937,840 with tick 0x30a14 = 199188, so the sum closes exactly as stated. One caveat for the method: the official endpoint ignores the block tag in eth_call (it returned the latest liquidity 0x1297fa6a5ff793 and a different slot0 for block 50,505,118), so parent state must come from the archive client, as the unit did. The logs of blocks 50,505,119 and 50,897,298 are byte identical on the official endpoint and the archive client, so the archive client serves the logs the network produced. own7.recheck.json and its empty mismatch file agree with the text.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2 (lead L-826): stage B over all 57,543 remaining m512? groups, 63,540 swaps, 0 mismatches.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The four group files hold 14,386 + 14,386 + 14,386 + 14,385 = 57,543 lines, the four mismatch files are empty, and the summary counts are internally consistent (13,500 + 1,019 + 49,012 + 9 = 63,540 by mode, 46,508 + 17,032 = 63,540 by steps). The clearance is narrower than its wording in two ways that should stay visible. 49,012 of the matches come from a fee search that treats the fee as a free parameter, so a fault that shifts an amount by an amount a different fee could absorb would pass; the Task 3 MULMOD plant shows the check still catches a one unit MULMOD fault, so this weakens and does not void the result. The reference is the Python transcription in tools/opdiff/v4math.py of src/libraries/FullMath.sol:14-116 and SqrtPriceMath.sol, and the pools run their own v3 fork bytecode, so the result says the validator's MULMOD, DIV and comparisons give the right words on these operands; it says nothing about the PoolManager's own bytecode paths. No code path in src/ is affected either way.

clearedSpotChecks.note: plant-mulmod.json.mismatch.jsonl has 405 lines, plant-tick 130, plant-fallback 0 and plant-none 0, and the logs end with the stated counts.
